summary: Sensei Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K providing unaudited pro forma financials for the conversion of Series B Preferred Stock into common stock, which will exceed 20% of outstanding shares and result in a change of control, requiring stockholder approval under Nasdaq Listing Rules 5635(a) and 5635(b). The conversion is to be voted on at the June 10, 2026 annual meeting. No price per share, premium, or advisor is disclosed. The pro forma data is illustrative and preliminary. Watch for stockholder vote outcome and potential Nasdaq compliance considerations.
